symbols.name: IEndpoints
symbols.summary: Defines a modular Minimal API endpoint set that can be registered with dependency injection and mapped by the endpoint system.
symbols.remarks: Implementations are discovered or registered as BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.IEndpoints services and are mapped by MapEndpoints. The mapper skips endpoint sets that are disabled or have already been registered, then marks successfully mapped instances as registered. Example: public sealed class TodoEndpoints : EndpointsBase { public override void Map(IEndpointRouteBuilder app) { app.MapGet("/todos", () => Results.Ok()); } }

symbols.name: Map(IEndpointRouteBuilder)
symbols.summary: Maps this endpoint set into the specified endpoint route builder.
symbols.remarks: Implementations should declare all Minimal API routes for the endpoint set. Endpoint classes that derive from BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.EndpointsBase can use BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.EndpointsBase.MapGroup(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing.IEndpointRouteBuilder%2cBridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.EndpointsOptionsBase) to apply shared group configuration.

parameters.description: The route builder that receives the endpoint mappings.
The route builder that receives the endpoint mappings.

symbols.name: Enabled
symbols.summary: Gets or sets whether this endpoint set should be mapped.
symbols.remarks: MapEndpoints reads this flag before calling BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.IEndpoints.Map(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing.IEndpointRouteBuilder). Disabled endpoint sets remain registered in dependency injection but are not mapped into the route table.

symbols.name: IsRegistered
symbols.summary: Gets or sets whether this endpoint set has already been mapped.
symbols.remarks: The mapping extension sets this property to true after invoking BridgingIT.DevKit.Presentation.Web.IEndpoints.Map(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing.IEndpointRouteBuilder). This prevents the same endpoint instance from being mapped more than once when MapEndpoints is called repeatedly.
